{{Infobox | title = Portal Architecture Specification | description = Integration of Wikipedia Systems portal architecture research into BITwiki's navigation framework. Analysis of interconnected Wikipedia portals reveals patterns for hub-and-spoke navigation, progressive disclosure, and cross-domain linking. | type = specification | author = BITCORE | created = 2026-02-11 | version = 2.0.0 | epistemic_status = Attribution-Traced | confidence = Emerging | license = CC-BY-SA-4.0 | ontology = entity_type: specification-document domain: research-integration | workflow = state: Beta }} = Portal Architecture Specification = == From Wikipedia Systems Research to BITwiki Navigation Framework == '''Version:''' 2.0 | '''Date:''' 2026-02-12 | '''Source:''' Wikipedia Systems Research ---- == Executive Summary == This specification integrates Wikipedia Systems portal architecture research into BITwiki's navigation framework. Analysis of interconnected Wikipedia portals reveals patterns for hub-and-spoke navigation, progressive disclosure, and cross-domain linking that inform BITwiki's portal system design. === Key Research Findings === | Metric | Wikipedia Pattern | BITwiki Adaptation | |--------|-------------------|-------------------| | Section Flexibility | 13 average, variable | Context-dependent structure | | Category Depth | 4-5 levels | Scalable taxonomy | | Portal Connectivity | 20 average links | Rich interconnection | | Taxonomy Structure | Hierarchical | Adaptive hierarchy | ---- == 1. Portal Architecture Principles == === 1.1 Core Design Philosophy === '''Wikipedia Pattern:''' Hub-and-spoke with progressive disclosure '''BITwiki Implementation:''' ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ BITWIKI PORTAL ARCHITECTURE │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ │ │ META HUBS │───→│ DOMAIN PORTALS│───→│ TOPICAL PORTALS│ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ • Systems │ │ • Science │ │ • Networks │ │ │ │ • Research │ │ • Technology │ │ • Complexity │ │ │ │ • Knowledge │ │ • Humanities │ │ • Cybernetics│ │ │ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ └───────────────────┼───────────────────┘ │ │ ↓ │ │ ┌──────────────┐ │ │ │ CROSS-LINKS │ │ │ │ (Rich mesh) │ │ │ └──────────────┘ │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` === 1.2 Portal Types === | Type | Description | Examples | Characteristics | |------|-------------|----------|-----------------| | '''Meta Hub''' | Root navigation nodes | Systems Science, Research Methods | Multi-domain coverage, broad scope | | '''Domain Portal''' | Subject area hubs | Complexity Science, Network Science | Domain focus with adjacent connections | | '''Topical Portal''' | Specific topic focus | Network Theory, Cybernetics | Thematic depth, specialized content | | '''Functional Portal''' | Process/Method oriented | Quantitative Methods, Analysis | Methodology-centered | | '''Temporal Portal''' | Time-based organization | History of Systems, Evolution | Chronological structure | | '''Comparative Portal''' | Cross-domain synthesis | Comparative Analysis, Integration | Multi-perspective views | ---- == 2. Portal Structure Framework == === 2.1 Flexible Section Architecture === '''Based on Wikipedia Analysis:''' | Section | Priority | Content Type | Purpose | |---------|----------|--------------|---------| | '''Introduction''' | Required | Static overview | Establish context | | '''Selected Content''' | Required | Rotating featured content | Showcase quality | | '''Categories''' | Required | Taxonomy navigation | Structural access | | '''Related Portals''' | Required | Cross-domain links | Network navigation | | '''Selected Biography''' | Recommended | People highlights | Human dimension | | '''Current Developments''' | Recommended | Recent updates | Temporal relevance | | '''Topics''' | Recommended | Sub-domain index | Granular access | | '''Resources''' | Optional | Curated materials | Deep engagement | | '''References''' | Optional | Key sources | Verification | | '''External Links''' | Optional | Outbound resources | Extended context | '''Section Content Specifications:''' ==== Introduction Section ==== ```markdown {{Portal:Introduction | name = Systems Science | image = Systems_Science_Diagram.svg | description = Systems science is an interdisciplinary field that studies complex systems and their behaviors. | scope = Includes complexity theory, cybernetics, network science, and dynamical systems | parent = [[Portal:Research_Methods]] }} ``` ==== Selected Content Section ==== ```markdown {{Portal:SelectedArticle | article = [[Topic:Complexity_Theory]] | excerpt = Complexity theory studies how complex systems emerge from simple interactions, revealing patterns across biology, economics, and technology. | image = Complexity_Network.png }} ``` ==== Categories Section ==== ```markdown {{Portal:Categories | root = Systems Science | depth = adaptive | display = tree }} ``` ==== Related Portals Section ==== ```markdown {{Portal:Related | parent = [[Portal:Research_Methods]] | siblings = [[Portal:Mathematics]], [[Portal:Computer_Science]] | children = [[Portal:Network_Analysis]], [[Portal:Complexity_Modeling]] | related = [[Portal:Cybernetics]], [[Portal:Information_Theory]] }} ``` ---- == 3. Category Taxonomy Design == === 3.1 Adaptive Hierarchical Structure === '''Wikipedia Pattern:''' 3-5 levels maximum depth '''BITwiki Implementation:''' ``` Root Category: [Portal Name] │ ├── Core Concepts │ ├── Fundamental Principles │ ├── Key Theories │ ├── Methods & Techniques │ └── Applications │ ├── Domain Areas │ ├── [Specific Domain 1] │ ├── [Specific Domain 2] │ └── [Additional Domains as needed] │ ├── Related Fields │ ├── Adjacent Discipline 1 │ ├── Adjacent Discipline 2 │ └── [Dynamic expansion] │ └── Resources ├── Organizations ├── Publications ├── People └── Tools & Software ``` === 3.2 Category Naming Conventions === | Pattern | Example | Usage | |---------|---------|-------| | '''Field + Aspect''' | "Systems Science Concepts" | Core content categories | | '''Aspect + Type''' | "Complexity Theories" | Thematic groupings | | '''Domain + Application''' | "Network Analysis Methods" | Applied categories | | '''Entity Type''' | "Systems Scientists" | People/organizations | | '''Temporal + Domain''' | "History of Cybernetics" | Chronological categories | === 3.3 Cross-Category Linking === Each category should link to: * Parent category (structural) * Sibling categories (contextual) * Related portal categories (semantic) ---- == 4. Interconnection Strategy == === 4.1 Portal Link Architecture === | Portal Type | Link Approach | Diversity | |-------------|--------------|-----------| | Meta Hub | Rich multi-domain | Cross-cutting connections | | Domain Portal | Domain-centric with bridges | Adjacent fields | | Topical Portal | Thematic clustering | Related concepts | | Functional Portal | Method-based | Applicable domains | | Temporal Portal | Chronological | Period connections | | Comparative Portal | Multi-perspective | Synthesis views | === 4.2 Link Categorization === ``` Portal Links Include: ├── Parent Portal (structural hierarchy) │ └── Meta-hub or domain parent ├── Sibling Portals (same level) │ └── Related at same hierarchical level ├── Child Portals (specialization) │ └── More specific sub-topics ├── Related Domains (semantic) │ └── Adjacent fields and concepts ├── Cross-Cutting Themes (transversal) │ └── Shared concepts across domains └── External Resources (extension) └── Sister projects, external sites ``` === 4.3 Relationship Indicators === | Symbol | Relationship | Example | |--------|--------------|---------| | ↑ | Parent portal | ↑ Systems Science | | → | Sibling portal | → Mathematics | | ↓ | Child portal | ↓ Network Theory | | ↔ | Bidirectional | ↔ Complexity Science | | ⇄ | Strong coupling | ⇄ Cybernetics | | ⊕ | Cross-cutting | ⊕ Information Theory | ---- == 5. BITwiki Portal Network == === 5.1 Portal Network Architecture === ``` BITCORE Knowledge Base (Root) │ ├── Meta Hubs │ ├── [[Portal:Systems_Science]] │ ├── [[Portal:Research_Methods]] │ ├── [[Portal:Knowledge_Management]] │ └── [[Portal:Integration_Synthesis]] │ ├── Domain Portals │ ├── [[Portal:Complexity_Science]] │ ├── [[Portal:Network_Science]] │ ├── [[Portal:Cybernetics]] │ ├── [[Portal:Information_Theory]] │ ├── [[Portal:Data_Science]] │ ├── [[Portal:Computational_Methods]] │ └── [[Portal:Philosophy_of_Science]] │ ├── Topical Portals │ ├── [[Portal:Network_Analysis]] │ ├── [[Portal:Complexity_Modeling]] │ ├── [[Portal:Agent-Based_Models]] │ ├── [[Portal:Dynamical_Systems]] │ └── [[Portal:Emergence_Patterns]] │ ├── Functional Portals │ ├── [[Portal:Quantitative_Methods]] │ ├── [[Portal:Qualitative_Methods]] │ ├── [[Portal:Mixed_Methods]] │ └── [[Portal:Computational_Analysis]] │ └── Temporal Portals ├── [[Portal:History_of_Systems_Thinking]] ├── [[Portal:Evolution_of_Complexity]] └── [[Portal:Future_of_Knowledge_Systems]] ``` === 5.2 Portal Network Visualization === 
graph TD
    BC[BITCORE_Knowledge_Base]

    BC --> SS[Portal_Systems_Science]
    BC --> RM[Portal_Research_Methods]
    BC --> KM[Portal_Knowledge_Management]

    SS --> COMP[Portal_Complexity]
    SS --> NET[Portal_Networks]
    SS --> CYB[Portal_Cybernetics]
    SS --> IT[Portal_Information_Theory]

    RM --> QM[Portal_Quantitative_Methods]
    RM --> QLM[Portal_Qualitative_Methods]
    RM --> DS[Portal_Data_Science]

    KM --> KG[Portal_Knowledge_Graphs]
    KM --> ONTO[Portal_Ontologies]
    KM --> SMW[Portal_Semantic_MediaWiki]

    %% Cross connections
    COMP --> NET
    NET --> CYB
    CYB --> IT
    QM --> DS
    QLM --> DS
    KG --> ONTO
    ONTO --> SMW
---- == 6. Technical Implementation == === 6.1 MediaWiki Configuration === ```php // LocalSettings.php additions for BITwiki portals // Enable portal namespace $wgExtraNamespaces[100] = "Portal"; $wgExtraNamespaces[101] = "Portal_talk"; // Portal-specific settings $wgPortalNavigationCacheExpiry = 3600; // 1 hour $wgPortalSelectedArticlePoolSize = 50; $wgPortalAutoRotationEnabled = true; ``` === 6.2 Template Structure === ```markdown {{Portal header | name = {{{name}}} | image = {{{image}}} | description = {{{description}}} | parent = {{{parent}}} }} {{Portal selected article | article = {{{article}}} | excerpt = {{{excerpt}}} | image = {{{image}}} }} {{Portal categories | root = {{{root_category}}} | depth = adaptive }} {{Portal related | portals = {{{portal_list}}} }} ``` === 6.3 Category Structure (JSON) === ```json { "portal": "Systems_science", "root_category": "Systems Science", "taxonomy": { "concepts": { "name": "Systems Science Concepts", "subcategories": [ "Emergence", "Feedback Loops", "Self-Organization", "Adaptation" ] }, "theories": { "name": "Systems Theories", "subcategories": [ "General Systems Theory", "Complexity Theory", "Cybernetics", "Chaos Theory" ] }, "methods": { "name": "Systems Methods", "subcategories": [ "Systems Analysis", "Systems Dynamics", "Network Analysis", "Agent-Based Modeling" ] } } } ``` ---- == 7. Maintenance & Governance == === 7.1 Portal Maintenance Roles === | Role | Responsibilities | Frequency | |------|-----------------|-----------| | '''Portal Curator''' | Content selection, quality review | Ongoing | | '''Taxonomy Steward''' | Category management, restructuring | As needed | | '''Link Manager''' | Cross-portal link maintenance | Periodic | | '''Technical Admin''' | Template updates, automation | As needed | === 7.2 Quality Indicators === | Metric | Indicator | Measurement | |--------|-----------|-------------| | Portal freshness | Content currency | Update frequency | | Link validity | Connection health | Working cross-portal links | | Category coverage | Taxonomic completeness | Article categorization | | User engagement | Interaction depth | Time on portal pages | ---- == 8. Integration with BITwiki Systems == === 8.1 Front Matter Integration === * [[BITwiki_How_to_Navigate.wiki]] - Portal navigation guide * [[BITwiki_Start_Here.wiki]] - Entry point with portal links * [[BITwiki_Naming_Conventions.wiki]] - Portal naming standards === 8.2 Ontology Integration === * [[BITwiki_Ontology_Index.wiki]] - Portal taxonomy alignment * [[BITwiki_Taxonomy_Architecture.wiki]] - Category structure * [[BITwiki_Semantic_Patterns.wiki]] - Portal semantic markup === 8.3 Governance Integration === * [[BITwiki_Community_Portal.wiki]] - Portal maintenance coordination * [[BITwiki_Administrator_Guide.wiki]] - Portal administration ---- == 9.
